name: @corbits-builder/writer
description: Writes any document the work needs, has it reviewed and puts documents in front of the person to approve.
author: Sawyer Cutler <sawyer@dirtroad.dev>

builder.when: A document needs writing or revising, of any kind: requirements, a build plan, a brief, an analysis, a manual or anything else; or a filed document needs a second opinion or the person's approval.
builder.unless: The person wants the thing itself built or changed, or only a mockup.

write.when: The person asks for any document that has no action of its own, such as a problem brief, constraints, a comparison of approaches, a competitor analysis, a security review or a user manual, or wants one revised.
write.unless: The document is the product requirements or the build plan, which have actions of their own, or the person wants the thing itself built or changed.

write-requirements.when: Something is to be built, of any kind, and what it must do should be written down or revised with what the person said.
write-requirements.unless: The person wants the thing itself built or changed, or only a mockup.

write-build-plan.when: Something is to be built and needs a build plan, or its plan revised: the stack, the phases of work and the checks.
write-build-plan.unless: What it must do is still being settled with the person.

review.when: You want a second opinion on a filed document before you rely on it or put it to the person.
review.unless: The person asked for something you can start directly.

approve.when: Filed documents are ready for the person to approve, with no open questions left.
approve.unless: The person chose to let you decide approvals, or the work is a change to something already built.

examples: do a security review of the plan
write up what the app should do
write requirements for a command-line tool
add offline mode to the requirements
I want to plan an app for my team
plan the data pipeline in Python
use Postgres in the plan instead
show me what I need to sign off

facts.approved:problem_brief: the person approved the current version of the problem brief, or leaves approvals to you
facts.approved:constraints: the person approved the current version of the constraints, or leaves approvals to you
facts.approved:approaches: the person approved the current version of the approaches, or leaves approvals to you
facts.approved:product_requirements: the person approved the current version of the product requirements, or leaves approvals to you
facts.approved:build_plan: the person approved the current version of the build plan, or leaves approvals to you

brand.guidelines.about: The brand's guidelines: voice, tone, and what to do and avoid, in the person's words, at a link they gave, or in a file they attached.
